programs.fixed_orientation:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((colors (filter (lambda (c) (and (!= c 0) (!= c 2))) (grid-colors g)))
                  (mc (first colors))
                  (reds (find-color g 2))
                  (mains (find-color g mc))
                  (mr (/ (for/sum ((p mains)) (first p)) (length mains)))
                  (mcc (/ (for/sum ((p mains)) (second p)) (length mains)))
                  (rr (/ (for/sum ((p reds)) (first p)) (length reds)))
                  (rcc (/ (for/sum ((p reds)) (second p)) (length reds)))
                  (dr (- rr mr))
                  (dc (- rcc mcc))
                  (vertical-fold (= 1 0))
                  (smin (lambda (xs)
                          (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (< a b) a b)) (first xs) (cdr xs))))
                  (smax (lambda (xs)
                          (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (> a b) a b)) (first xs) (cdr xs))))
                  (axis2 (if vertical-fold
                             (if (> dr 0)
                                 (- (* 2 (smin (map first reds))) 1)
                                 (+ (* 2 (smax (map first reds))) 1))
                             (if (> dc 0)
                                 (- (* 2 (smin (map second reds))) 1)
                                 (+ (* 2 (smax (map second reds))) 1))))
                  (reflected (if vertical-fold
                                 (map (lambda (p) (list (- axis2 (first p)) (second p)))
                                      mains)
                                 (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- axis2 (second p))))
                                      mains))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (or
                            (find (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c)))
                                  mains)
                            (find (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c)))
                                  reds)
                            (find (lambda (p) (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c)))
                                  reflected))
                          mc
                          3))))))
